Simulated shots

Source: R/data.R
shots.Rd

A synthetic set of unblocked shot attempts between two fictional teams, generated by data-raw/shots.R for examples and tests. Locations are plausible but invented, and xg comes from a toy distance-and-angle model, not a fitted one. All shots are taken towards the right-hand goal (the high-x end) of an IIHF rink, in metres with the origin at the bottom-left corner of the boards.

Usage

shots

Format

A data frame with 1,500 rows and 8 columns:

shot_id

Shot id.

game_id

Game id, 1-10.

period

Period, 1-3.

team

Shooting team, "Lakeside" or "Northfield".

x, y

Shot location, in metres.

xg

Expected-goal probability from the toy model.

goal

1 if the shot was a goal, else 0.
